tandem keys (agents in sidebar, main grid, status below)

Global (tmux)
  Help      Alt+h        open this help
  Agents    Ctrl+Alt+n   add an agent
            Ctrl+Alt+w   close the focused agent (asks first)
            Ctrl+Alt+r   restart an exited agent
  Tabs      Alt+Up       previous agent (sidebar order), shown alone
            Alt+Down     next agent (sidebar order), shown alone
  Status    Alt+s        focus the status window
            Alt+q        open the Queries tab
  Columns   Alt+1        show last planner
            Alt+2        show last implementer
  Quit      Ctrl+Alt+x   exit menu: save and exit, detach, update tandem, discard
  Layout    Ctrl+Alt+z   resize mode: arrows resize the focused pane, = resets, Enter exits
  Sidebar   Alt+b        focus the sidebar (popup when hidden)
  Settings  Alt+,        open Settings (grid, sidebar, Reset UI)

Sidebar & Grid
  Grid      Alt+PgUp / Alt+PgDn scroll the grid one row
  Equalize  double-click a border, or Ctrl+Alt+z then e

Status & Queries window
  Status    Tab          switch between tabs (1-7 direct)
            Alt+r        refresh the status now
            Alt+g        go to the highlighted or asking agent's pane
  Queries   Enter        answer the selected open question
            1-9          fill the answer with a numbered option
            Ctrl+S       send the answer
            Alt+w        mark the selected question withdrawn
            Esc          clear the draft and return to the list

Launch / add-agent wizard
  Model     Alt+f        focus the model filter
  Summary   Alt+a        add another agent
            Alt+d        delete the highlighted agent
            Shift+L      launch all configured agents
            Esc          back or cancel

Mouse
            click agent = show · Shift/Alt+click = add to grid · right-click menu
            double-click a border to equalize
            click a status-bar hint = press its key
            click a pane to focus it; drag a border to resize; scroll wheel scrolls
  Resize    Ctrl+Alt+z then arrows (←→ 5 columns, ↑↓ 2 rows) on the focused pane; = resets; Enter exits
  Custom    set TANDEM_KEYS="help=Ctrl+Alt+h,quit=Ctrl+Alt+q" (each needs at least one modifier)
  Detach    your agents keep running; run `tandem` again to re-attach
